decision.selected_method: independent positive_y physical replay of the existing bound native-feedback schedule

decision.hypothesis: The physical uncertainty is whether the current six-channel native-feedback controller has sufficient finite-time closed-loop authority to reject the positive-y impact while respecting tendon constraints, rather than merely tracking without an impulse. Competing hypotheses are H1: feedback recovers from the +0.04 N world-y half-sine pulse and satisfies every frozen threshold; H0: inadequate disturbance-rejection authority, saturation, or excessive tendon motion causes at least one recovery or safety failure. Resolve this with one independent positive_y physical replay of the existing bound candidate and schedule. This tests complete nonlinear closed-loop performance for one frozen condition; binding, configuration verification, nominal execution, and mathematical prediction cannot establish that scope.
decision.expected_observation: The positive_y replay completes without numerical failure, warnings, or unexpected contacts. Following the 0.50-0.55 s impact, tip position error returns to at most 0.01 m and tip speed to at most 0.02 m/s by 0.90 s and remains within both limits continuously through 1.00 s; tensions remain within [0,8] N, geometric tendon stroke remains at most 0.015 m, and actual tendon speed remains at most 0.025 m/s.
decision.weakening_observation: Failure to regain both tip limits by 0.90 s and maintain them for the required continuous 0.10 s final hold, or any tension, stroke, tendon-speed, contact, warning, or numerical violation, refutes H1 for positive_y. Passing positive_y would not establish negative_y or joint required-condition acceptance.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep frozen TASK T10 and all thresholds unchanged: current candidate and exact bound source; original design identity f0837aacfde3c795e7b305f3e074866425e2b585eb0a152c3ea2c5f6dd6df1e4; discretization identity 80569ca1c3c599e09fea0af343a770e5df15f3b5b1cc2b3e6ce406c282bb9768; six independent channels; zero qpos/qvel and 0.20 N initial input; target [0.29,-0.035,0.19] m; gravity [0,0,-9.81] m/s^2; +0.04 N world-y payload-COM half-sine pulse from 0.50 to 0.55 s; 1.00 s duration; 0.01 s control and sample periods; 0.0005 s timestep; original windows, evaluator, required signals, and failure policy. Do not modify controller, structure, geometry, task, or acceptance criteria.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after this one replay and inspect the complete evaluator result. Do not select or confirm the candidate unless independent passing physical replays exist for all required conditions positive_y, negative_y, and no_impulse on the identical structure.
decision.interpretation: Original evidence T10-220-bind-native-feedback-positive_y records the candidate/source binding with task_acceptance unmeasured, while T10-221-verify-native-feedback-original-positive_y records execution_started=false. Thus positive_y performance is UNKNOWN. T10-210 through T10-213 provide original-candidate and no_impulse context but cannot transfer acceptance to the impacted condition. The proposed replay has not run; it is the most direct feasible discriminator of disturbance rejection versus nominal-only tracking.
